blocks.text: Living in Lake Errock, near Mission and Agassiz

Lake Errock is an unincorporated Fraser Valley Regional District Electoral Area C community on a lake of the same name, along Highway 7 between Mission and Agassiz, near Harrison Mills. It is unincorporated land in Fraser Valley Regional District Electoral Area C, not part of Mission, Kent, or Harrison Hot Springs. Highway 7 (Lougheed Highway) is the main road in.

Homes for sale in Lake Errock include waterfront houses, cabins, and rural lots around the lake, with some strata or freehold properties near the local golf course. There is no urban shopping street; everyday services are a drive west into Mission or east toward Agassiz and Harrison Mills. The lake itself is the recreation focus, with a quieter setting than the resort village at Harrison Hot Springs.

Transit is limited; most trips are by car on Highway 7. Lake Errock is in the Mission School District (SD75). Nearby public schools include Deroche Elementary, with middle and secondary students often attending schools in Mission. Check the SD75 school locator. Confirm well and septic servicing, lakeshore rules, floodplain designation, and zoning with the FVRD for a specific parcel.

items.t: This page covers the unincorporated community of Lake Errock, on the lake of the same name near Harrison Mills, east of Mission. Listings here show the "Lake Errock" area and a Mission mailing address, on streets including Bayview Road, Malcolm Road, Morris Valley Road and Lougheed Highway.

Plans: the regional district's Electoral Area C Official Community Plan (Bylaw 1747, 2024, adopted September 18, 2025) applies, and includes a Lake Errock Neighbourhood Plan. It replaced the older plan for Morris Valley, Harrison Mills and Lake Errock (Bylaw No. 0020, 1998).

Neighbours, as references only: Harrison Mills (west, in the same Electoral Area C plan area), the District of Kent / Agassiz (east, across the Harrison River side), and Mission (west, the nearest city) — none of them governs Lake Errock.
The FVRD's own election notice places "Harrison Mills–Lake Errock portion of Area C" voters in the School District No. 75 (Mission) rural trustee election, alongside Deroche (Area G) voters.
The former Area C OCP (Bylaw No. 0020, 1998) included geological-hazard and environmentally-sensitive development permit areas.
Listing-card drive-time claims ("20 mins to Mission") are not adopted.

items.t: The plan for this community is brand new. The FVRD adopted a new Electoral Area C Official Community Plan — Bylaw 1747, 2024, adopted September 18, 2025, with a dedicated Lake Errock Neighbourhood Plan — replacing a consolidated plan from 1998 (Bylaw No. 0020).

There is no school to walk to, in either direction, without a district check. No school sits in Lake Errock on the Ministry record; the FVRD notice ties the area to SD75 trustee elections, SD78 schools sit across the river at Agassiz, and no catchment document for a Lake Errock address was opened — a family buying here is buying a drive, in a district they must confirm first.

items.t: Lake Errock is unincorporated land in the regional district's Area C, whose plan area runs "from the Harrison River to the east of Deroche and includes Morris Valley, Harrison Mills, Lake Errock, and the eastern portions of the Deroche Bench." The current Area C Official Community Plan (Bylaw 1747, 2024, adopted September 18, 2025) includes a Lake Errock Neighbourhood Plan and replaced the 1998 plan (Bylaw No. 0020).
Where the townhouses are: there aren't any.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Lake Errock

parts.t: The rules that apply across Abbotsford (zoning, suites, strata, land and taxes) are on one page:
buying a home in Abbotsford: the rules

items.t: Even with no townhouses, this matters: if you're comparing a Morris Valley strata lot (Tapadera, Eagle Point or River Reach) with a city townhouse, you need to know both the strata rules that apply to those bare-land and single-family stratas, and that most of the community is fee simple. Both are covered below.

For any strata purchase here (Tapadera, Eagle Point or River Reach), read the Form B: it shows the monthly fee, amounts owing, approved special levies, the contingency reserve balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, budget, any rental disclosure and the latest depreciation report. The strata must provide it within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page. On a bare-land strata, the Form B and bylaws also show what you can put on the lot (RV, park model or manufactured home); a listing doesn't.

Plans are set by the regional district, not a city: the Area C Official Community Plan (Bylaw 1747, 2024, adopted September 18, 2025), including the Lake Errock Neighbourhood Plan, replaced the 1998 plan. Tapadera's development guide refers to Zoning Bylaw No. 1638 (2021) for holiday park requirements. Check a specific lot's designation, permit areas and allowed homes with the regional district.
Do not apply Surrey's, Mission's or any city's SSMUH tiers here.

On ALR land: one main house of up to 500 m², a suite only inside it, and at most one additional home of 90 m² (parcels of 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (larger). ALR homes can't be stratified, so a farm can't be turned into townhouse strata lots.

Property taxes follow the rural rules, which differ from Mission's: Lake Errock is unincorporated, so the tax notice comes from the Province's Surveyor of Taxes and you pay the Province, not the regional district or a city. Rural taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty on anything unpaid then and another 5% on anything unpaid on October 31. Mission's flat 10% penalty doesn't apply here.

blocks.text: Good to know about Lake Errock townhomes

items.t: The Electoral Area C OCP, Bylaw 1747, 2024, was adopted September 18, 2025 and includes a dedicated Lake Errock Neighbourhood Plan, replacing Bylaw No. 0020, 1998.

Two different "strata" products share one road and neither is a townhouse. Morris Valley Road carries a bare-land RV/park-model strata (Tapadera, LMS648, Harrison Mills side) and detached estate-home stratas (Eagle Point, River Reach) within a short drive of each other — a buyer comparing monthly fees across them is comparing a recreation lot's services against a golf-course estate's, not two versions of the same purchase.
The lake's boating character is listing text, not an official finding. Confirm frontage, dock tenure and boating rules on title and with the FVRD/Province before marketing water access.

There is no Lake Errock price figure to quote. SnapStats publishes no median, $/sq ft, sale-to-list or days-on-market figure for the sub-area — pricing evidence has to come from the property's own comparables, and Mission's published medians describe a city market across the river.

items.t: Governance: Lake Errock is FVRD Electoral Area C land. The FVRD's Area C OCP page states the plan area "spans from the Harrison River to the east of Deroche and includes Morris Valley, Harrison Mills, Lake Errock, and the eastern portions of the Deroche Bench." The FVRD is the local government; City of Mission and District of Kent bylaws, zoning and tax rules do not apply here.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Lake Errock

items.t: OCP: FVRD Electoral Area C Official Community Plan, Bylaw 1747, 2024 — adopted by the Regional Board on September 18, 2025 — current: It includes dedicated Neighbourhood Plans for Harrison Mills and Lake Errock and replaces the former consolidated OCP Bylaw No. 0020, 1998 (titled for "Portions of Area C: Morris Valley, Harrison Mills, Lake Errock").
Zoning / subdivision / servicing (FVRD): FVRD zoning applies lot by lot.

Bare-land strata rules (for a lot like Tapadera's): the Form B, with the rules, budget and latest depreciation report, must be provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page. Stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years, and at least 10% of the budget must go into the reserve. Rental bans are void (short-term rentals can still be limited), and the only valid age bylaw is 55 and older, so a "45+" listing line isn't enforceable.

faq.a: The homes are lake houses, cottages, acreages, estate-style homes and manufactured homes.
faq.q: Are there any condos in Lake Errock?

faq.a: The Province: rural properties get their tax notice from the Surveyor of Taxes and pay the Province, not the regional district or a city. Rural taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty on amounts unpaid then and another 5% on amounts unpaid on October 31.
faq.q: Who do I pay property tax to on a Lake Errock property?

faq.a: Both names come only from listings, for estate-style homes on Morris Valley Road, not from a developer or strata, so I can't say whether they're strata. Check the title and any strata plan for a specific property.
faq.q: Are Tapadera Estates and Eagle Point Estates condo developments?

faq.a: If you need a townhouse, look in Mission, Chilliwack or the Harrison area, not at the lake.
faq.q: Can I actually buy a townhouse in Lake Errock?

faq.a: A bare-land strata lot (Strata Plan LMS648) that you own, for an RV, park model or manufactured home under the strata's lot-development rules — with a strata fee, a Form B package and strata bylaws, not a pad rental and not a townhouse. Fresh listings call it "Freehold bareland strata" in terms.
faq.q: Tapadera Estates looks like a townhouse park — what am I buying?

faq.a: No. It's freehold strata in single-family form: detached estate homes on strata lots beside Sandpiper Golf Course (a current listing shows Single Family Residence on freehold strata title). The fee pays for strata services (grounds, management and snow removal, per the listing), and the Form B is still the key document, but the home is a house, not a townhouse.
faq.q: Eagle Point charges a monthly fee — is it a townhouse strata?

faq.a: The Province (the Surveyor of Taxes), under the rural rules: taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty on amounts unpaid then and another 5% on amounts unpaid on October 31. Mission's flat 10% penalty doesn't apply here.
faq.q: Who do I pay property tax to, and what is the penalty?

faq.a: Strata tenure on the lot itself (Strata Plan LMS648) — you own the lot as a strata lot, pay strata fees for the common property (clubhouse, pool, river access on the strata's own site), and take a Form B; an RV, park model or manufactured home on the lot does not change the tenure. It is not fee-simple.
faq.q: What is a bare-land strata lot at Tapadera Estates?

faq.a: The Province — rural notice from the Surveyor of Taxes Office; due Jul 2, 5% on amounts unpaid on Jul 2 and a further 5% on amounts unpaid on Oct 31.
faq.q: Who do I pay property tax to?

faq.a: The manufactured-style homes here are in stratas: Tapadera Estates (bare-land strata lots for RVs, park models and manufactured homes) and Eagle Point (freehold strata, single-family homes), both on Morris Valley Road.
faq.q: Is there a mobile home park in Lake Errock?

faq.a: You own a bare-land strata lot (Plan LMS648) — you pay strata fees, follow the registered bylaws and get a Form B, and the lot carries your RV, park model or manufactured home under the strata's lot-development rules. It is not a pad rental: there is no park owner, no pad rent and no MHPTA tenancy.
faq.q: What does "bare-land strata" at Tapadera actually mean?

faq.a: No. Eagle Point is freehold strata with detached estate homes on strata lots (built in 2017, according to a listing), and Tapadera is bare-land strata. Both are stratas, so you read the Form B; neither is fee simple or a pad rental.
faq.q: Is Eagle Point the same form as Tapadera?

faq.a: No — for mailing and board reporting it carries a Mission address and the board groups its name under Mission, but Lake Errock is an unincorporated Fraser Valley Regional District Electoral Area C community: the FVRD's Area C Official Community Plan page names Lake Errock among the communities in its plan area, and the City of Mission does not govern it.
faq.q: Is Lake Errock part of Mission?

faq.a: For counts, yes: the board reports Lake Errock separately, under Mission. In September 2026, 16 detached homes were listed and 1 sold (6% of those listed), and 1 condo or townhome was listed with none sold. There's no median price for Lake Errock; medians are published only for Mission as a whole, and those aren't Lake Errock's.
faq.q: Is there a market statistic for Lake Errock?

faq.a: The Fraser Valley Regional District. Its Area C Official Community Plan (Bylaw 1747, 2024, adopted September 18, 2025) covers Lake Errock and includes a Lake Errock Neighbourhood Plan; it replaced the 1998 plan (Bylaw No. 0020). Regional district zoning applies lot by lot, so check a specific lot's designation, permit areas and allowed homes with the regional district.
